text:
ashok: Quick postmortem follow-up from the GPU surge on Mar 10. Laying out action items, owners, and timelines. I'll capture and we can assign. TL;DR: autoscaler saturated, quota limits hit for p4 pools, need scheduler tuning + headroom plan.
maria: thanks. can you drop the owner list? I can take the quota follow-up if needed.
jia: I'll look at scheduler tuning (preemption thresholds + scale-up cooldown). suspect current cool_down=120s is too long.
oliver: we should consider soft quota increase for p4-preempt to give headroom during burst.
sre-bot: Incident summary: 2026-03-10 03:22Z GPU utilization spike -> autoscale failed to keep up -> 12% request errors. Root cause: scale-up throttled by provider quota + aggregated small requests starving batch slots.
ashok: plan: 1) quota request (owner: maria, due 2026-03-17) 2) scheduler tuning PR (owner: jia, due 2026-03-12) 3) headroom policy doc + runbook (owner: sam, due 2026-03-19) 4) canary rollout of autoscaler config (owner: oliver, due 2026-03-15). who can own follow-up to validate metrics post-change?
sam: I'll own the headroom doc and runbook. will put a draft in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
maria: filing the quota ticket now, linking ticket #INC-4521. ETA request to cloud team: 7 days.
jia: scheduler tuning note: propose reduce scale_up_cooldown from 120 -> 30, increase max_batch_wait from 5 -> 8ms. quick patch:
```
autoscaler:
  scale_up_cooldown: 30
  max_batch_wait_ms: 8
```
I'll open PR and add perf bench.
oliver: for canary, suggest route 10% traffic to dedicated pool -> ramp 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 48h, with rollback hook if p95 latency > 250ms.
ashok: assigning reviewers: jia -> infra, oliver -> platform, maria -> procurement for quota. We'll have a sync Fri 2026-03-13 10:00 PT. Please add blockers here.
maria: added ticket link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4521 and put owners + due dates in checklist.
sre-bot: Reminder: weekly capacity retro every Tue 09:00 PT. Next one: 2026-03-16.
jia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/789. bench results attached (roughly x1.2 scale-up speed).
sam: draft runbook: https://docs.redwood/ops/headroom-runbook (WIP). will ping when ready.
oliver: note — we should verify billing impact for soft quota bump. finance pinged.
ashok: thanks all. action items recorded. I'll update the postmortem doc with timelines and close this thread after the March 19 checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
maria: ack
